import json
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.lines import Line2D
import matplotlib.patheffects as pe

# Load data
with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

cars = data['cars']['data']

dims = ['price_score', 'fuel_efficiency', 'power', 'safety', 'interior_space', 'resale_value', 'emission_rating']
dim_labels = ['Price\n(Affordability)', 'Fuel\nEfficiency', 'Power', 'Safety', 'Interior\nSpace', 'Resale\nValue', 'Emission\nRating']

# Colors for vehicle types - business theme
type_colors = {
    'SUV': '#2196A0',      # teal
    'Sedan': '#E67E22',    # orange
    'Electric': '#27AE60'  # green
}
type_alpha = {
    'SUV': 0.75,
    'Sedan': 0.75,
    'Electric': 0.75
}

# Find top performer per axis
top_per_axis = {}
for dim in dims:
    best_val = -1
    best_car = None
    for car in cars:
        if car[dim] > best_val:
            best_val = car[dim]
            best_car = car
    top_per_axis[dim] = (best_car['model'], best_val)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(16, 9))
fig.patch.set_facecolor('#F8F9FA')
ax.set_facecolor('#F8F9FA')

n_dims = len(dims)
x_positions = np.linspace(0, 1, n_dims)

# Draw axis lines
for i, (xp, label) in enumerate(zip(x_positions, dim_labels)):
    ax.axvline(xp, color='#CCCCCC', linewidth=1.5, zorder=1)
    ax.text(xp, 103, label, ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9.5, fontweight='bold', color='#333333',
            multialignment='center')

# Draw polylines per car
# Sort so Electric drawn last (on top), then Sedan, then SUV
type_order = ['SUV', 'Sedan', 'Electric']

# Collect lines grouped by type
lines_by_type = {t: [] for t in type_order}
for car in cars:
    vals = [car[d] for d in dims]
    lines_by_type[car['type']].append((car['model'], vals))

for vtype in type_order:
    color = type_colors[vtype]
    alpha = type_alpha[vtype]
    lw = 1.6 if vtype != 'Electric' else 1.8
    for (model, vals) in lines_by_type[vtype]:
        # Normalize to 0-100 scale (already done)
        ax.plot(x_positions, vals, color=color, alpha=alpha, linewidth=lw, zorder=2, solid_capstyle='round')

# Highlight top performers per axis with a star/dot and annotation
for i, dim in enumerate(dims):
    model_name, best_val = top_per_axis[dim]
    car_obj = next(c for c in cars if c['model'] == model_name)

# Colors for vehicle types - business theme
type_colors = {
    'SUV': '#2196A0',      # teal
    'Sedan': '#E67E22',    # orange
    'Electric': '#27AE60'  # green
}
type_alpha = {
    'SUV': 0.75,
    'Sedan': 0.75,
    'Electric': 0.75
}

# Find top performer per axis
top_per_axis = {}
for dim in dims:
    best_val = -1
    best_car = None
    for car in cars:
        if car[dim] > best_val:
            best_val = car[dim]
            best_car = car
    top_per_axis[dim] = (best_car['model'], best_val)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(16, 9))
fig.patch.set_facecolor('#F8F9FA')
ax.set_facecolor('#F8F9FA')

n_dims = len(dims)
x_positions = np.linspace(0, 1, n_dims)

# Draw axis lines
for i, (xp, label) in enumerate(zip(x_positions, dim_labels)):
    ax.axvline(xp, color='#CCCCCC', linewidth=1.5, zorder=1)
    ax.text(xp, 103, label, ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9.5, fontweight='bold', color='#333333',
            multialignment='center')

# Draw polylines per car
# Sort so Electric drawn last (on top), then Sedan, then SUV
type_order = ['SUV', 'Sedan', 'Electric']

# Collect lines grouped by type
lines_by_type = {t: [] for t in type_order}
for car in cars:
    vals = [car[d] for d in dims]
    lines_by_type[car['type']].append((car['model'], vals))

for vtype in type_order:
    color = type_colors[vtype]
    alpha = type_alpha[vtype]
    lw = 1.6 if vtype != 'Electric' else 1.8
    for (model, vals) in lines_by_type[vtype]:
        # Normalize to 0-100 scale (already done)
        ax.plot(x_positions, vals, color=color, alpha=alpha, linewidth=lw, zorder=2, solid_capstyle='round')

# Highlight top performers per axis with a star/dot and annotation
for i, dim in enumerate(dims):
    model_name, best_val = top_per_axis[dim]
    car_obj = next(c for c in cars if c['model'] == model_name)
    vtype = car_obj['type']
    color = type_colors[vtype]
    xp = x_positions[i]
    # Draw highlighted dot
    ax.scatter([xp], [best_val], s=120, color=color, edgecolors='white', linewidths=2.5,
               zorder=6, marker='*')
    # Small label below the dot
    ax.text(xp, best_val - 4.5, model_name, ha='center', va='top', fontsize=6.5,
            color=color, fontweight='bold', zorder=7,
            bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.15', fc='white', ec=color, alpha=0.85, linewidth=0.8))

# Draw tick marks on each axis
for i, xp in enumerate(x_positions):
    for tick in [0, 25, 50, 75, 100]:
        ax.plot([xp - 0.008, xp + 0.008], [tick, tick], color='#AAAAAA', linewidth=0.8, zorder=3)
    ax.text(xp - 0.012, 0, '0', ha='right', va='center', fontsize=7.5, color='#888888')
    ax.text(xp - 0.012, 100, '100', ha='right', va='center', fontsize=7.5, color='#888888')

# Axis limits and cleanup
ax.set_xlim(-0.05, 1.05)
ax.set_ylim(-10, 118)
ax.axis('off')

# Legend
legend_elements = [
    mpatches.Patch(facecolor=type_colors['SUV'], label='SUV (9 models)', alpha=0.85),
    mpatches.Patch(facecolor=type_colors['Sedan'], label='Sedan (8 models)', alpha=0.85),
    mpatches.Patch(facecolor=type_colors['Electric'], label='Electric (8 models)', alpha=0.85),
    Line2D([0], [0], marker='*', color='w', markerfacecolor='#555555', markersize=12,
           label='Top performer on axis'),
]
ax.legend(handles=legend_elements, loc='lower center', ncol=4,
          frameon=True, framealpha=0.95, edgecolor='#CCCCCC',
          fontsize=9.5, bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, -0.02))

# Title and subtitle
fig.text(0.5, 0.97, 'No Perfect Car: Trade-offs Across 7 Dimensions', ha='center', va='top',
         fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', color='#1A1A2E')
fig.text(0.5, 0.935, 'Parallel coordinates of 25 models (SUV, Sedan, Electric) — score 0–100, higher is better on all axes',
         ha='center', va='top', fontsize=10, color='#555555')

# Annotation callouts for key trade-offs
# Power vs Fuel Efficiency crossings note
ax.annotate('Power ↔ Fuel Efficiency\ntrade-off: frequent\nline crossings',
            xy=(x_positions[2], 62), xytext=(x_positions[2] + 0.095, 30),
            fontsize=7.8, color='#444444', ha='left',
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='#888888', lw=1),
            bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', fc='#FFFDE7', ec='#CCAA00', alpha=0.92))

# Electric emission note
ax.annotate('Electric vehicles\ncluster near 98\non emissions',
            xy=(x_positions[6], 98), xytext=(x_positions[6] - 0.14, 72),
            fontsize=7.8, color='#27AE60', ha='center',
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='#27AE60', lw=1),
            bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', fc='#E8F8F0', ec='#27AE60', alpha=0.92))

# SUV space note
ax.annotate('SUVs lead\ninterior space',
            xy=(x_positions[4], 93), xytext=(x_positions[4] + 0.09, 80),
            fontsize=7.8, color='#2196A0', ha='left',
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='#2196A0', lw=1),
            bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', fc='#E3F7FA', ec='#2196A0', alpha=0.92))

plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0.06, 1, 0.93])
plt.savefig('/app/output/result.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight', facecolor=fig.get_facecolor())
print("Saved to /app/output/result.png")
